hero.description: I build easy-to-use web interfaces, paying attention to every detail from layout to interaction.

profile.title: Good interfaces start with people.
profile.intro: I'm Dat, a front-end developer. I enjoy turning ideas into clear, approachable web applications with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and the React ecosystem.

projects.title: Ideas into products.
projects.intro: A selection of business websites, e-commerce experiences and community applications.

kada.summary: A clear introduction to KADA's products and services, helping visitors find information and send enquiries.
kada.problem: Present the company, products and services through an approachable homepage.
kada.scope: Company introduction, product and service sections, and a contact form.
kada.contribution: Designed and built the homepage and integrated the contact form.

ai-shoe.summary: An online shoe store combining product discovery with an AI-powered recommendation assistant.
ai-shoe.problem: Help shoppers find suitable products in an online shoe catalogue.
ai-shoe.scope: Storefront, product discovery and an assistant for shopping recommendations.
ai-shoe.contribution: Responsible for the React frontend of the online shoe store.

tdtu-find.summary: A lost-and-found application for students, with item listings, photos and contact information.
tdtu-find.problem: Connect students who have lost items with people who have found them.
tdtu-find.scope: Lost-and-found listings, item descriptions, images and contact details.
tdtu-find.contribution: Responsible for both the frontend and backend of the lost-and-found application.

richard.summary: A spa course website bringing together video learning and an affiliate programme.
richard.problem: Bring course information and the learning journey together on one website.
richard.scope: Course discovery, student accounts, videos and an affiliate programme.

drink-shop.summary: An online water shop with a product catalogue, shopping cart and store management area.
drink-shop.problem: Connect the shopping experience with product and order management.
drink-shop.scope: Product catalogue, cart, inventory, orders and sales reports.

app-marketplace.summary: An app and game marketplace with discovery, purchasing, downloads and seller product management.
app-marketplace.problem: Bring discovery and distribution of applications and games into one space.
app-marketplace.scope: Digital product catalogue, search, reviews and seller management.
